column1: # NetMHCIIpan 4.3 -- licensed, free for academic use, from DTU Health Tech:
# Two parts, requested separately on that page: the software tarball and the
# data tarball. After installing, edit NMHOME in the netMHCIIpan wrapper to
# point at the install directory -- it ships with the author's path baked in,
# and the failure is at runtime, not at install. chpc-tool doctor checks it.
# Nothing in this pipeline calls NetMHCIIpan yet; the immunogenicity filter
# is wired to skip and flag when NETMHCIIPAN is empty.
# columns, tab separated:  filename / sha256 / dest / mode / note

column5: the wrapper script; edit NMHOME after installing
